summary: Iteration 9 isolation + expanded catalog verified. Built /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_isolation.py (15 pytest tests) — ALL PASSED. Backend: (a) GET /api/projects returns 6 projects and 28 units, every unit has image_front + image_layout; (b) /api/developer/projects is correctly scoped — dev1 sees only {Griya KORPRI Harmoni, Bumi ASN Residence}, dev2 only {Persada Abdi Negara, Persada Grande Living}, dev3 only {Karya Nyaman Village, Nyaman Hills Premier}, admin sees all 6; (c) cross-developer PUT /api/developer/projects/{id_of_other_dev}, POST /api/developer/units on other's project, and PUT/DELETE /api/developer/units/{other_dev_unit} all return 403; (d) /api/developer/spr-queue is empty for every dev (expected — fresh SEED_VERSION=3 wiped bookings) and no project leakage; (e) /api/kpr/applications empty for BTN and DKI (correct empty-scoped) and admin can list; (f) /api/stats works for every role. Frontend: DeveloperDashboard for dev1/dev2/dev3 renders only that developer's 2 projects (verified via body text). Consumer login → home shows 6 project cards → open project detail → click unit-row opens dialog rendering house photo AND 'Layout Rumah' image (data-testid unit-detail-layout present with valid src) and 'Pesan Unit' booking button reachable. No console/CORS errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Cross-bank PATCH /api/kpr/applications/{id} 403 path was NOT dynamically exercised because no KPR applications exist post-reseed (SEED_VERSION=3 wiped bookings). Code inspection of server.py (update_kpr_status) shows correct check `if user.role=='bank_evaluator' and app.bank != user.bank: raise 403`, but recommend driving one booking→pay(webhook)→SPR-approve flow in next iteration to get end-to-end coverage.
server.py is a 1100-line monolith; consider splitting into routers per resource for maintainability (carry-over from iteration_8).
Login response uses key 'token' rather than the more conventional 'access_token' — fine, but worth documenting so future test authors don't guess wrong (I hit this initially).
